query:
SELECT
                bp.bill_id,
                bp.participant_id,
                COALESCE(u.full_name, sp.guest_name, 'Unknown') as name,
                bp.amount_paid
            FROM bill_payers bp
            JOIN session_participants sp ON bp.participant_id = sp.id
            LEFT JOIN users u ON sp.user_id = u.id
            WHERE bp.bill_id = ANY($1)
